state.asymptotic_integer_obstruction: When p > 4*sqrt(q), trace congruence a_q(E) == a_q(f) mod p forces exact integer equality a_q(E) = a_q(f) in Z
state.deep_height_barrier: Bases up to 10,000, exponents up to 50, sums up to 10^28, open signature (3, 4, 7) with C up to 5,000 and B up to 1,000,000

asymptotic_integer_rigidity.instructions: When p > 4*sqrt(q), does the Hasse-Weil bound |a_q(E) - a_q(f)| <= 4*sqrt(q) rigorously force the mod p congruence a_q(E) == a_q(f) (mod p) into an exact integer identity in Z?

criteria.true: Difference |a_q(E) - a_q(f)| is an integer multiple of p strictly smaller than p, forcing the difference to be exactly 0
criteria.false: Non-trivial multiples of p can occur within the Hasse interval

kraus_elimination_rate_25k.instructions: What is the expected elimination rate of the Kraus sieve across the 20,001 to 25,000 prime exponent range against newforms 72a1 and 144a1 with auxiliary multipliers k <= 300?

criteria.100_percent: 100% elimination rate achieved across all prime exponents
criteria.partial_elimination: Some prime exponents resist elimination within k <= 300

height_barrier_penetration.instructions: Does extending the search to C <= 5000 for signature (3, 4, 7) and B <= 1,000,000 push the certified height barrier beyond BealHeight > 10^6?

criteria.true: Empirical height barrier is extended to larger base domains
